# ISOPARTNER AS

> > ISOPARTNER AS is a Norwegian technical insulation distributor with 30+ years of experience serving HVAC, marine, oil & gas, and industrial sectors across Scandinavia.

ISOPARTNER AS is a leading supplier of thermal, acoustic, and fire protection insulation solutions in Norway, part of the IPCOM Group European network. The company specializes in high-performance insulation products from premium manufacturers including Armacell, Rockwool, Paroc, and Kaimann.

## Key Topics

- Technical Insulation
- Thermal Insulation
- Pipe Insulation
- Fire Protection
- Sound & Noise Insulation
- Marine & Offshore
- Oil & Gas Industry
- HVAC Systems
- Corrosion Protection (CUI)
- Armacell
- Rockwool
- Paroc
- IPCOM Group
- Process Industry
- Building Materials

## Products & Solutions

- [PRODUKTER & LØSNINGER | ISOPARTNER](https://www.isopartner.no/nb/produkter-losninger): Isopartner main products and solutions for insulation needs
- [Termisk isolering | ISOPARTNER](https://www.isopartner.no/nb/produkter-losninger/termisk-isolering): Thermal insulation products: ArmaFlex, Glava pipe solutions
- [Høytemperatur isoleringsløsninger | ISOPARTNER](https://www.isopartner.no/nb/produkter-losninger/hoytemperatur-isoleringslosninger): High-temperature insulation for marine, offshore, heavy industry
- [Passiv Brannsikring | ISOPARTNER](https://www.isopartner.no/nb/produkter-losninger/passiv-brannsikring): Passive fire protection products and systems catalog
- [Lyd- og støyisolasjon | ISOPARTNER](https://www.isopartner.no/nb/produkter-losninger/lyd-og-stoyisolasjon): Sound and noise insulation solutions for acoustic comfort
